svg.text: Claude Code Plugin · v0.11.0 · Migrate legacy web apps (ASP.NET WebForms/MVC, Java JSP/Spring, AngularJS 1.x, PHP, ColdFusion…) to modern stacks
Install: /plugin marketplace add <path-to-this-repo> · /plugin install web-modernize · Start: /web-modernize:init
PLUGIN REPO — C:\1\web-mordernize (plugin source, installed once)
Frameworks — 31 .md files (drop 1 file = add 1 stack, no skill edits needed)
Multi-developer: each unit has its own file — Alice edits units/LoginPage.json, Bob edits units/OrderForm.json → zero git conflicts
USER REPO — team's legacy application (state created here)
target stack · auth model · scope · constraints · DB · test coverage… (team fills in after /init)
Legacy source codebase (original app — untouched · /analyze reads it · migration.md §1 defines its path)
State shared via git · per-unit file split → different devs touch different files → zero merge conflicts · /sync reconciles on git pull
PER-UNIT MIGRATION STATES (one units/<id>.json per unit — each unit migrates independently)
heartbeat.mjs bumps last_heartbeat on every Write
Parity gate: parity-reviewer subagent compares target ↔ legacy; unacknowledged high-severity diffs block migrated→verified · /parity-check reviews & acknowledges · --no-parity opts out
• /retry <unit> — re-attempt failed unit (resets in_flight, reruns translation)
• /abandon --unit <id> — mark as skipped (excluded from progress count)
Staleness: /status flags in_progress units with last_heartbeat > 15 min as available for re-acquisition by /next
github.com/balaji-hari/web-mordernize · Plugin namespace: web-modernize · State schema v3 · 16 skills · 4 agents · 31 framework files
